verdicts.reason: Both break the layout the same way. The body copy is printed over the teal circle, and the circle is split off from the can, so the product loses its backdrop. The GLACIER wordmark sits below the headline, which inverts brand-then-message order, and the body copy comes first on the left, ahead of the product and headline. The CTA pill is tiny and crammed against the badges. B is slightly worse because its body copy is jammed against the left canvas edge (about 4px margin) and the can floats further from the circle, while A at least keeps a small left margin.
